---
applyTo: "**/*.tsx,**/*.jsx,**/*.vue,**/*.cshtml,**/*.razor,**/*.html,**/*.css"
---

- Aim for WCAG 2.2 AA: keyboard access, visible focus, labels on every input, sufficient contrast.
- Every screen handles five states: loading, empty, error, partial and success.
- Show form errors next to the field, in plain words, and keep what the person typed.
- Use Laya's plain-English words for members. Show dates as DD/MM/YYYY and money in €.
